title: Spain Fiscal Configuration (SII and SAF-T ES): Layer 1 — Property foundation
text: Layer 1 — Property foundation Path: Administration Enterprise Properties [Property] Set Country Mode to ES (Spain). Set the Region to the autonomous community. The region drives which police authority receives guest arrival notifications.

title: Spain Fiscal Configuration (SII and SAF-T ES): Layer 2 — OPERA Controls
text: Layer 2 — OPERA Controls Path: Administration Enterprise OPERA Controls Enable Country Specific Functions for Spain. Enable SII submission. Configure VAT rates per Spanish IVA law. Standard VAT rates in mainland Spain. Rate Use case 4 percent Reduced (specific cases) 10 percent Reduced (accommodation, restaurants) 21 percent Standard Canary Islands use IGIC at different rates. Ceuta and Melilla use IPSI. Configure regional rate sets accordingly.

title: Spain Fiscal Configuration (SII and SAF-T ES): Layer 3 — Role permissions
text: Layer 3 — Role permissions Grant SII Submission, Reprint Fiscal Folio, and Modelo 347 access to authorised roles only.

title: Spain Fiscal Configuration (SII and SAF-T ES): Layer 4 — Transaction codes
text: Layer 4 — Transaction codes Standard ranges per Spanish hospitality practice. Range Purpose 1xxx Room revenue 2xxx F&B revenue 3xxx Other revenue 5xxx Adjustments 6xxx Statistical 7xxx Payment methods 8xxx IVA codes (per rate and region) 9xxx Deposit and internal ledger codes Map each transaction code to the correct IVA classification and Modelo 347 category.

title: Spain Fiscal Configuration (SII and SAF-T ES): Layer 5 — Invoice types F1 through F6
text: Layer 5 — Invoice types F1 through F6 AEAT defines invoice classifications used in SII submission. Type Description Use F1 Factura completa Standard invoice F2 Factura simplificada Simplified invoice (small amounts) F3 Factura emitida en sustitución de facturas simplificadas Substitution of simplified invoices F4 Asiento resumen de facturas Summary entry F5 Importaciones (DUA) Import documents F6 Otros justificantes contables Other accounting documents Folio types in OPERA Cloud must map to the correct F type. Configure at Administration Financial Cashiering Management Folio Types.

title: Spain Fiscal Configuration (SII and SAF-T ES): Layer 6 — SII configuration
text: Layer 6 — SII configuration Path: Administration Financial Fiscal Management SII Setup SII (Suministro Inmediato de Información) requires real time submission of invoice data to AEAT within 4 calendar days of invoice issuance. Configure SII Web Service endpoint, digital certificate, NIF, and registration data per Oracle Spain Fiscal Reference Guide. Confirm submission categories. Libro registro de facturas expedidas Libro registro de facturas recibidas Libro registro de bienes de inversión Libro registro de determinadas operaciones intracomunitarias

title: Spain Fiscal Configuration (SII and SAF-T ES): Layer 7 — Regional police export
text: Layer 7 — Regional police export Path: Miscellaneous Exports Country Spain requires guest arrival notification to the competent police authority within 24 hours. Format and recipient depend on autonomous community. Region Authority Format Catalunya Mossos d'Esquadra Per Mossos specification País Vasco Ertzaintza Per Ertzaintza specification Other Cuerpo Nacional de Policía or Guardia Civil Per Hospederías specification Configure the export per the destination authority. Validate test arrivals before going live.

title: Spain Fiscal Configuration (SII and SAF-T ES): Layer 8 — INE statistics
text: Layer 8 — INE statistics INE Encuesta de Ocupación Hotelera (EOH) is a monthly statistical submission required from accommodation establishments above a size threshold. Configure the INE export at Miscellaneous Exports Country. Output includes occupancy by room nights, guest nationality breakdown, market segment, and revenue per available room.

title: Spain Fiscal Configuration (SII and SAF-T ES): Layer 9 — Modelo 347
text: Layer 9 — Modelo 347 Annual declaration of operations with third parties where the total annual operation with any single party exceeds the AEAT threshold (currently EUR 3,005.06). Generate from Reports for the calendar year. Validate against AR and supplier transactions.

title: Spain Fiscal Configuration (SII and SAF-T ES): Layer 10 — Validation and go-live
text: Layer 10 — Validation and go live Verification gate. Do not approve go live until each is true. VAT codes correct per region (mainland, Canary, Ceuta, Melilla) F1 through F6 mapped to all folio types SII test submission accepted by AEAT Regional police export accepted by the correct authority INE export validated against test month Modelo 347 dry run produces expected totals

title: Spain Fiscal Configuration (SII and SAF-T ES): Common issues
text: Common issues SII submission rejected with timestamp error: confirm server clock and timezone match AEAT requirements Police export rejected by Mossos but accepted by Ertzaintza: each authority uses a distinct format, not generic IGIC posting incorrectly in Canary Islands property: confirm regional VAT code set selected at property Modelo 347 missing supplier: confirm supplier exceeds annual threshold and is registered in AR Derived from publicly available Oracle documentation, Spanish tax law (Real Decreto 596/2016, Ley General Tributaria), AEAT technical specifications and INE EOH methodology. title: SSD Interface Service Account — Manage and Troubleshooting Guide: Purpose
text: Purpose Manage Interface Service Accounts in Oracle Identity Self Service. These accounts authenticate third party interfaces (channel managers, POS, RMS, payment, key systems) to OPERA via web service calls. Without a valid service account, the interface cannot connect.

title: SSD Interface Service Account — Manage and Troubleshooting Guide: Access path
text: Access path URL: https://[Hostname]/identity Credentials supplied in the Welcome Letter from the OPERA property administrator. From Home Manage Users to reach the User Management screen.

title: SSD Interface Service Account — Manage and Troubleshooting Guide: Create Interface Service Account
text: Create Interface Service Account Click +Create on the Users screen.

title: SSD Interface Service Account — Manage and Troubleshooting Guide: Request Information
text: Request Information Effective Date: empty Justification: empty

title: SSD Interface Service Account — Manage and Troubleshooting Guide: Basic Information
text: Basic Information Tenant Code: auto populates when Organization selected First Name: name representing the interface service (e.g. SiteMinder, Simphony, IDeaS, FreedomPay) Middle Name: empty Last Name: property name E Mail: valid contact email, preferably a distribution list so password expiry alerts reach the team. Never use an @oracle.com domain. Manager: empty Organization: prefix with letter I plus property code. Example: IHB4X4 User Type: Other (from dropdown)

title: SSD Interface Service Account — Manage and Troubleshooting Guide: Account Settings
text: Account Settings User Login: reflects interface type. For backup accounts append bkup suffix to the primary login name. Password: must meet policy (below) Confirm Password: re enter Multi Factor Authentication: unchecked

title: SSD Interface Service Account — Manage and Troubleshooting Guide: Password Policy
text: Password Policy 24 to 30 characters Must start with an alphabetic character Must contain at least 2 alphabetic characters At least 1 uppercase At least 1 lowercase At least 1 numeric At least 1 special character Must not match or contain First Name, Last Name, or User Login Default expiration: 1 year Email notification: 30 days before expiry

title: SSD Interface Service Account — Manage and Troubleshooting Guide: Account Effective Dates
text: Account Effective Dates Start Date: defaults to account creation date if empty. For backup accounts: set 30 days after primary account start date. This staggers expiry so both accounts never lock out together. End Date: when populated, account expires and is deleted on that date. Empty means account persists until manually deleted. Expiration notification fires 30 days before End Date to the email address on the account.

title: SSD Interface Service Account — Manage and Troubleshooting Guide: Provisioning Dates
text: Provisioning Dates Provisioning Date: empty De provisioning Date: empty

title: SSD Interface Service Account — Manage and Troubleshooting Guide: Contact Information, Preferences, Other Attributes
text: Contact Information, Preferences, Other Attributes All optional. Keep empty.

title: SSD Interface Service Account — Manage and Troubleshooting Guide: Submit
text: Submit Notification email sent to the contact address with login URL and credentials.

title: SSD Interface Service Account — Manage and Troubleshooting Guide: Backup account principle
text: Backup account principle For every primary Interface Service Account, create a backup with: Identical attributes User Login appended with bkup Start Date 30 days after primary The 30 day stagger is the entire point. If the primary account locks or expires, the backup is already active and can be swapped in immediately. Without the stagger both accounts often share the same renewal failure mode.

title: SSD Interface Service Account — Manage and Troubleshooting Guide: Quick Search
text: Quick Search Select search type from dropdown (User Login, First Name, Last Name, Identity Status, E mail, Start Date, End Date, Display Name, Account Status, Organization). Enter parameter. Click search icon.

title: SSD Interface Service Account — Manage and Troubleshooting Guide: Advanced Search
text: Advanced Search Match Type: All: results must match all criteria Any: results matching any one criterion Click Search. Click User Login link to open User Details.

title: SSD Interface Service Account — Manage and Troubleshooting Guide: Add WSACCESS Role
text: Add WSACCESS Role Without the WSACCESS role the service account exists but cannot call any OPERA web service. This is the single most common reason interfaces fail after account creation. Path: User Details Roles tab Request Roles. 1. Search keyword: WSACCESS 2. From results, select the WSACCESS role for your organisation, chain, or property code 3. Do not select roles prefixed with I (these are tied to the OIM integration organisation, not your property) 4. Add to Cart 5. Next review cart Update Grant Duration if needed 6. For permanent interfaces: tick "Grant will be effective immediately upon request completion", then Update 7. For test or temporary interfaces: untick, assign Start Date and End Date matching usage period, Update 8. Submit

title: SSD Interface Service Account — Manage and Troubleshooting Guide: Account Expiration
text: Account Expiration Default expiration: 1 year from activation Notification: 30 days before expiry, to the email on the account Oracle recommendation per security compliance: shorten to 90 days If password is not reset before expiry, account becomes permanently disabled. No reactivation. Backup account must take over.

title: SSD Interface Service Account — Manage and Troubleshooting Guide: Lockout Policy
text: Lockout Policy 10 failed login attempts locks the account. OPERA property administrator must unlock. The threshold is hard and cannot be configured per Oracle policy.

title: SSD Interface Service Account — Manage and Troubleshooting Guide: Error 401 Unauthorized / OSB-386200 General Web Service Security Error
text: Error 401 Unauthorized / OSB 386200 General Web Service Security Error Cause: invalid credentials, or password changed. Action: property administrator resets password. Stop the interface and update the credentials in the interface configuration before restart , otherwise repeated failed login attempts will lock the account inside the 10 attempt window.

title: SSD Interface Service Account — Manage and Troubleshooting Guide: Error: User is not authorized for the hotel code in the payload
text: Error: User is not authorized for the hotel code in the payload Cause: WSACCESS role not assigned for the property chain referenced in the payload. Action: review roles assigned to the service account. Add the correct chain WSACCESS role.

title: SSD Interface Service Account — Manage and Troubleshooting Guide: Operational checklist
text: Operational checklist Per property, document: Primary account User Login Backup account User Login (with bkup suffix) Email distribution list Activation date for primary Activation date for backup (primary + 30 days) Expiration date for both Assigned WSACCESS role exact name Interface owner contact Vendor contact Rotate 30 days before expiry. Reset primary password, validate interface still authenticates, then reset backup password.

title: SSD Interface Service Account — Manage and Troubleshooting Guide: Tiago notes
text: Tiago notes For multi property rollouts, the email field should always be a distribution list owned by the property IT or operations team, never a single named person. People leave, distribution lists persist. The recommendation to shorten expiry from 1 year to 90 days is good security hygiene but creates four rotation events per year per property. For a 20 property EMEA portfolio that is 80 events per year. Build an n8n workflow that monitors expiry dates and triggers rotation alerts 35 days out. Same workflow can post to Slack and create a Notion task. Common failure pattern: vendor takes credentials, embeds them in their config, account expires, vendor blames OPERA, takes a day to diagnose. Document the credential handover process with sign off. Vendor acknowledges expiry date in writing. Channel manager service accounts (SiteMinder, SynXis, Profitroom) almost always need a chain level WSACCESS, not property level. Verify the exact role name with the channel manager partner before assignment.

title: Oracle OPERA Cloud Training Course Catalogue: Tiago notes
text: Tiago notes The official catalogue has 20 courses. For most EMEA chain rollouts, the 40 hour, 5 day training schedule covers courses 9 through 16, with 17 and 18 added for the interface owner. Reporting and Analytics (19) and OPERA Cloud Reporting (20) overlap. R&A is the cloud analytics layer, the latter is the in product reporting. Decide which the property uses before scheduling. OSEM courses (8 and 16) are skipped for PMS only properties. Verify the property scope before booking trainer time. Identity and Access Management (1) is the most under trained course and the most often blamed when go live fails. Make sure the property has at least one trained admin before cutover. For partner supported properties, the trainer typically covers operational courses on site over 5 days. Configuration courses are usually self paced via Oracle University before the trainer arrives.

title: OPERA Cloud PMS Training Schedule — 40 Hours / 5 Days: Tiago notes
text: Tiago notes The 40 hour schedule assumes a mid sized property with full PMS, blocks, cashiering, and housekeeping. Limited service or PMS only sites may compress to 24 to 32 hours. OSEM properties require an additional 16 to 24 hours on top of this schedule. Plan for 7 day delivery if OSEM is in scope. Day 4 (Cashiering and Night Audit) is the most operationally critical. Schedule the strongest cashiers and the night auditor for this day specifically. The Q&A block on Day 5 should not be filled with new content. Resist the urge to use it for catch up. Property staff need the open time to ask the awkward questions they did not ask in front of colleagues earlier in the week. For multi language properties, request a translator or bilingual trainer in advance. Oracle typically delivers in English; not all EMEA properties have full English fluency on the floor. For partner managed rollouts, training is often split across two trainers (operational and configuration). Coordinate calendars early.
